page.overview:
Who is Dimitri?

Dimitri was a criminal operative of the secretive criminal organisation, SPECTRE. A minor antagonist portrayed by Bill Baskiville, he appeared in the 1965 James Bond film, Thunderball.

Dimitri is one of Emilio Largo's henchmen who was on the deck when James Bond made photos of the Disco Volante. After he seen in Palmyra when 007 tried to save Paula Caplan.

After Bond escapes from the villa, Dimitri, Ricardo, Fiona Volpe, Janni and several others SPECTRE operatives pursue him to the Kiss Kiss Club, where Volpe approaches Bond as he is dancing with another woman. Assuming Volpe is his wife, the woman abruptly leaves, and the pair begin slow-dancing. As they dance one of the henchmens takes aim at Bond from behind a nearby curtain. Bond notices in time and spins Volpe into the path of the bullet, piercing her spine and killing her instantly. Witnessing the death of their superior, Dimitri and the remaining thugs flee.
